title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良
summary: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。
summaryEn: Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「原土含水比的機理與驗證」與「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" and "Binder dosage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「原土含水比」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Native-soil water content” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。不同土層即使加入相同膠結材量，也可能有不同水膠比及反應性；有機物、鹽分與黏土礦物更會改變強度發展，不能只按深度統一配比。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「原土含水比」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. Equal binder dosage in different layers can produce different water-binder ratios and reactivity. Organics, salinity and clay minerals further alter strength development, so depth alone cannot justify one universal mixture. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Native-soil water content” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「原土含水比」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Native-soil water content”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。不同土層即使加入相同膠結材量，也可能有不同水膠比及反應性；有機物、鹽分與黏土礦物更會改變強度發展，不能只按深度統一配比。
knowledge.textEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. Equal binder dosage in different layers can produce different water-binder ratios and reactivity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「原土含水比的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。
原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。
每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
optionsEn: Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass.
Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass.
Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
quiz.explanation: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原土含水比」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Native-soil water content” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「原土含水比的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 工具名目直徑就是每個深度都已證明的成品直徑。
面積加權模數越大就表示所有失效模式都更安全。
原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。
optionsEn: Nominal tool diameter proves the finished diameter at every depth.
A larger area-weighted modulus improves safety for every failure mode.
Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原土含水比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Native-soil water content” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。
knowledge.textEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
knowledge.textEn: Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原土含水比的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification"?
options: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
將不同地層全部平均，可以更準確代表最弱位置。
optionsEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Averaging all strata gives a more accurate description of the weakest location.
quiz.explanation: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Native-soil water content mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「原土含水比」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Native-soil water content” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。
knowledge.textEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「原土含水比的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Native-soil water content mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。
每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity.
Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
quiz.explanation: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「膠結材用量」如何影響深層攪拌樁地盤改良的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Binder dosage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。投入量只能描述供料，成品強度還受混合均勻、反應時間及土種影響；流量計與密度計誤差可能沿整根柱累積而不易被外觀發現。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「膠結材用量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. Input describes supply, while strength also depends on uniformity, reaction time and soil type. Flow and density errors can accumulate along a column without producing visible surface evidence. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Binder dosage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「膠結材用量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Binder dosage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. Input describes supply, while strength also depends on uniformity, reaction time and soil type.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Binder dosage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。
每米攪拌轉數越高，就一定有同比例的強度增加。
膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。
optionsEn: Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
More rotations per metre necessarily increase strength proportionally.

quiz.explanationEn: Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「膠結材用量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Binder dosage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。
相鄰柱有幾何交疊，就必定像單一整體一樣工作。
固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg.
Geometrically overlapping columns necessarily act as one monolithic body.
Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「膠結材用量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Binder dosage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records. Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Binder dosage mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。
漿液沒有返出就表示全部留在正確位置且沒有副作用。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records.
No slurry return means all material remains correctly placed without adverse effects.
quiz.explanation: 校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Binder dosage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「膠結材用量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Binder dosage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。
knowledge.textEn: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「膠結材用量的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Binder dosage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每米攪拌轉數越高，就一定有同比例的強度增加。
流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
More rotations per metre necessarily increase strength proportionally.
Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance.
quiz.explanation: 流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
